whatIs: SEESAW is a web inspiration gallery of hand-picked sites, updated daily. Each entry shows the favicon, the name and a one-line description, and links to its own detail page. You can browse by category (Agency, AI, Crypto, Design Tools, Developer Tools, E-Commerce, Fintech, Hardware, Portfolios, Productivity, Social, among others) or use a search box that covers sites, fonts and categories, with a ⌘K shortcut.
It's a good fit when you want to see how products in a specific field present themselves, especially tech ones such as developer tools or AI startups.
uses: Browsing the Developer Tools category to see how other tools similar to yours present their landing page.
Searching by typeface to find sites that use a font you're evaluating.
Looking at the Portfolios category before redesigning your personal site.
caveats: Categories are by industry, with no style or color filters, so for a specific visual direction you have to browse by eye.
The listing shows only the favicon and a short description; to see the design you have to open the detail page or the site.
It leans heavily toward tech sites and startups; other industries are less represented.
pricingNote: Free; the newsletter is also free, and there's one form to submit sites and another to sponsor.
idealFor: Developers looking for product landing page references, especially from tools and startups.
